title: Validity, Reliability and Responsiveness of King's Sarcoidosis Questionnaire in a Danish Population
brief_summary:
The King's Sarcoidosis Questionnaire (KSQ) is a brief questionnaire assessing health status in patients with sarcoidosis. The KSQ was previously validated in English German and Dutch.

KSQ will be translated into Danish and validated in a Danish sarcoidosis population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with sarcoidosis
* Signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability or unwillingness to adhere to the study
* Inability to give informed consent
study_population: Danish patients with sarcoidosis seen in Department of Respiratory Diseases Aarhus Denmark
